title: Follow functionality
description: Follow primary tags and authors from tag, author, and article pages. Preferences screen to manage follows.
notes: Release 2 — Foundations. Needs preference storage and retrieval during browsing. Closely coupled with Homepage feed filter — following is most impactful when it visibly affects the homepage experience.

title: Author pages — featured articles
description: Let authors pin 3–4 featured articles above their chronological list.
notes: Quick win. Also relevant to EscapeStack.

title: Bookmarks / read it later
description: Save posts to a personal read-later list with a management view.
notes: New feature — needs save/retrieve storage. Supports the 23% of members who cite offline access as a desired app benefit.

title: Daily news uplift
description: App-like daily news — swipeable cards, read/unread state, remembers position.
notes: Survey: 59% of members rate daily news as essential — tied with editorial articles as the top content priority. Wade sees it as a top-of-funnel acquisition tool. Needs internal editorial workflow definition.

title: Member benefits uplift
description: Replace the list of plain buttons with a more engaging benefits experience (RCC app as reference).
notes: Survey: 33% of members cite member benefits access as essential — higher than the community forum (18%). Members feel they aren't accessing what they're paying for. High-value, relatively low-effort win.

title: Native app (Capacitor) — iOS & Android
description: Pivot to native app development using Capacitor after site refresh. Wraps existing web app in a native shell — no rewrite. Solves iOS IAB issue and enables true deep linking on both platforms.
notes:
Agreed with Wade in Aug 2026 catch-up. Priority immediately after site refresh ships. Target: end of 2026. Denis to implement using Capacitor — web-friendly, no prior native experience needed, compatible with existing PWA work. OneSignal Capacitor plugin available. Solves the IAB problem on iOS — strongest concrete driver.

Investigate Apple 30% tax: check whether current paid members are subject to it via in-app subscriptions, and whether web-only sign-up can route around it.

title: Homepage feed filter (follow-based)
description: Tag/author filter applied to the top section of the homepage, based on who you follow. Lets members quickly surface content from their favourite tags or authors without changing the full homepage layout.
notes:
Agreed scope (Aug 31 2026): NOT full homepage layout customisation — just a filter on the top section based on followed tags/authors. Also enables EC-curated collections (e.g. "Tour de France"). Follow functionality is a prerequisite.

Wade's concern about complexity was resolved once the narrower scope was clarified. Start with tag filtering; author filtering can follow.

title: Racing experience overhaul
description: Rich pre-race / in-race / post-race experience. "In Race" is the primary focus — live racing + community interaction. Post-race to consider HTRWW.
notes:
Extends Release 1 Racing tab. Leans on race-data-api. Paused until more fully formed.

TV Guide backend is a related dependency for pre-race HTRWW data.

title: Member purchase program uplift
description: Better MPP interface with search/filter as the vendor count grows — current cards are heavy on mobile.

title: Podcasts on homepage
description: Surface podcasts on the homepage for discoverability — better than the current static panel.
notes: Survey: 31% rate podcasts as essential content.

title: Announcements
description: An announcements page (feed) plus a dismissible homepage banner linking to each announcement. On-platform member comms channel.
notes: Release 2 — Foundations. Open question: Ghost's built-in banner may not support hyperlinks — may need a custom build.

title: Comments uplift
description: Review and improve the comment thread experience; the slide-in sidebar is up for revision.
notes: Survey: 32% of members rate post comments as essential — more than the forum (18%). Underrated in the pipeline relative to its member importance.

title: Comments platform — Discourse migration
description: Review replacing Coral Comments with Discourse threads to consolidate community tools.
notes: Discourse full app embed is already live on the EC instance. Would eliminate a separate platform dependency.

title: Offline reading
description: Read articles (likely bookmarked ones) without a connection.
notes: Survey: 23% cite offline access as a desired app benefit — more than push notifications (8%). Worth revisiting once Bookmarks ships.

title: Author page banner
description: A custom banner on author pages for personalisation and branding.
notes: Also relevant to EscapeStack.

title: Follower counts
description: Show follower counts on author pages, possibly above a threshold.
notes: Depends on Follow shipping first (Release 2).

title: TV Guide backend
description: Manage "how to watch" information centrally from the race calendar and expose throughout the site — race previews, annual calendar, etc.
notes: Feeds into Racing Experience overhaul for pre-race and in-race context.

title: Browse by primary tags
description: Browse and discover the back catalogue via primary tags and sub-tags (currently only via search).
notes: Closely related to Follow — could ride alongside Release 2.

title: Account consolidation
description: Consolidate scattered settings (Ghost, member benefits, forum, newsletter, push prefs) into one experience.
notes: Ties directly into the follow-preferences screen in Release 2.

title: Galleries uplift
description: Mobile-optimised galleries — portrait images and vertical video, including from the homepage.
notes: Galleries achieve higher completion rates than articles. Team to produce more vertical video to support.

title: Merch integration
description: At minimum link to the merch store in more places; deeper integration later.
notes: Survey: 6% rate merch as essential. Low priority. Supplier hosts their own store.

title: Fantasy integration
description: Expose/integrate Fantasy for discoverability. Leaderboard panel exists but needs a rethink for the new homepage design.
notes: Survey: 11% rate Fantasy as essential.

title: Author pronouns
description: A place to represent authors' preferred pronouns on their profile.
notes: Requires a backend change for where pronouns are set.

title: BikeGrid integration
description: Expose/integrate BikeGrid for discoverability.
notes: Survey: 7% rate BikeGrid as essential. Low member priority.

title: EscapeStack — identifiable content
description: Visually differentiate EscapeStack content from core EC content across feeds, article and tag pages.
notes: Blocked: EscapeStack concept not defined enough to progress.

title: EscapeStack — identifiable contributors
description: Differentiate EscapeStack contributor author pages and profile presence from core staff.
notes: Blocked: as above.

title: EscapeStack — homepage discovery
description: A homepage area surfacing EscapeStack content, which won't hit the homepage by default.
notes: Blocked: depends on EscapeStack definition.

title: Weather POC for cyclists
description: A proof of concept for a cyclist-focused weather feature.
notes: Novelty / utility value. Unvalidated demand — worth a quick POC before committing.
